name: PivotFilter
description: A PivotFilter is applied to a PivotField object.
remarks: Developers have the option of naming filters for reference because the index is not reliable. The DataField property specifies the PivotField to base a value filter on.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified PivotFilter object. Read-only.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Specifies the evaluation order of the filter among all Value filters applied to the entire PivotTable. Read/write Integer.

properties.name: FilterType
properties.description: Specifies the type of filter to be applied. Read-only XlPivotFilterType.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: This property provides the option of naming filters for reference. You cannot rely on the index value for accurate reference because this value can change.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Provides an optional description for the PivotFilter object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: Returns whether the specified PivotFilter is active. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: PivotField
properties.description: Specifies the PivotField to which the filter is applied. Read-only.

properties.name: DataField
properties.description: This property is applicable only to non-OLAP PivotTables and provides the Value field (PivotField in the Values area) being filtered by for a value filter. Read/write PivotField.

properties.name: DataCubeField
properties.description: This property is applicable only to OLAP PivotTables and provides the Value field (PivotField in the Values area) being filtered by for a value filter. Read/write CubeField.

properties.name: Value1
properties.description: This property is a user-supplied parameter to define a filter for a PivotField. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Value2
properties.description: This property is a user-supplied parameter to define a filter for a PivotField. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: MemberPropertyField
properties.description: This property specifies the member property PivotField on which the label filter is based. Read/write PivotField.

properties.name: IsMemberPropertyFilter
properties.description: Specifies whether the label filter is based on the PivotItem captions of a member property of the field or on the PivotItem captions of the PivotField itself. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: WholeDayFilter
properties.description: Sets or gets the filtering semantics for date filters. Read/write Boolean.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the filter and removes it from the filter collections of the PivotField and the PivotTable.
